title: The 4 Best Packing Cubes for Family Trips
h1: The 4 Best Packing Cubes for Family Trips
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for packing cubes for family trips, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at packing cubes for family trips using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Gonex Compression Packing Cubes 10 Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Double zipper compression on every cube, See-through mesh panels, Honeycomb ripstop fabric.
strengths: 10 pieces split easily across 2 or 3 suitcases, one XL and one large per adult, medium cubes for kids
Dedicated shoe and laundry bags keep dirty items away from clean clothes without buying extras
limitations: One color per set makes it harder to tell whose cube is whose without labeling
Compression zippers show wear first under the heavy use a family trip puts on them
Only one XL cube per set, a second set is needed for a family of 5 or more
features: Double zipper compression on every cube

products.name: TravelWise Packing Cube System 5 Piece Weekender Plus Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 cubes: 1 small, 2 medium, 2 large, Available in multiple colors, Mesh top panel on each cube.
strengths: Available in enough colors to assign a distinct color per family member
2 medium plus 2 large cubes covers a full week of one traveler's clothing
limitations: No compression zipper, bulkier items take up their full volume
Thinner fabric than premium sets, needs gentler handling
Small cube is the only size below medium, less flexibility for tiny kids' items
features: Mesh top panel on each cube

products.name: eBags Classic 4 Piece Packing Cube Set
products.blurb: Key specs: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim, TechLite diamond nylon construction, YKK zippers throughout.
strengths: Durable enough to survive years of repeated family trips without seam failures
Slim cube is well suited to a parent's extra layer or travel documents folder
Backed by a lifetime warranty, useful for gear that gets more wear from daily family use
limitations: Higher per-piece price than Gonex or TravelWise for a family buying multiple sets
Only one set of 4 sizes, less specialty storage (no dedicated shoe bag) than the Gonex system
features: 4 cubes: large, medium, small, and slim

products.name: Eagle Creek Pack-It Specter Cube Set (S/M)
products.blurb: Key specs: Set of 2 cubes: small and medium, 70D recycled ripstop nylon, Translucent mesh top.
strengths: Small and medium sizes match a young child's clothing volume well
Translucent top helps kids find their own items without adult help
Ripstop fabric survives rough handling by kids better than standard nylon
limitations: Only 2 cubes per set, a family needs several sets to cover everyone
Highest per-piece price in this list
No compression, doesn't help with bulky kids' items like winter coats
features: Set of 2 cubes: small and medium

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
